firms.expected_pv_gap_loss_usd_m.note: physical gap mapped to the unconditional country scenario-loss distribution

firms.gap_risk_charge_bps.note: lambda*k*sigma(PV gap loss), annualized; p_bind is not multiplied twice

formula: PV_loss_j = sum_t DF_t * G_t * max(P_j - P_reference, 0)
aggregation_warning: Gap-linked and transition-cost charges are alternative result bases. Do not sum them until their covariance and joint state model are specified.

risk_result_contract.uncertainty: loss distribution plus assumed lambda and k
risk_result_contract.interpretation: gap-linked charge on its own basis; not additive to transition-cost charge
